experiment_data.hypothesis: Binary Probe GRPO: frozen linear probe output binarized (P(syc)>0.5→R1=0, else R1=1) as GRPO R1 reward signal. Detached probe with stop-gradient prevents adversarial gaming (unlike exp-008 where continuous probe was gamed in ~30 steps). If Binary Probe GRPO ≈ DC-GRPO, direction projection adds no value beyond binary classification; if DC-GRPO > Binary, continuous directional information is the critical differentiator.
